finding_summary: WP805 generation 1 should be a thin evaluator layer over WP800, not a new planner, model, truth store or effect path.
Use two immutable matched WP800 fixtures for before/after change rather than mutating a live EpisodeState; this preserves fixture/generation/provenance fences.
Compare SELECTIVE_REPAIR against the same policy/planner class doing FULL_REPLAN from identical post-change public inputs and budget.
Compute a post-change evaluator-only shortest-valid-action oracle only for regret/path-length measurement; never expose oracle path or changed-edge truth to the SUT.

Reuse WP800 holdout_set_id/evidence_source_family/donor_path_family/method_family; add perturbation/topology family axes only as WP805 evaluator metadata unless later evidence justifies a shared schema change.
WP802 information seeking and WP803 action-bound prediction are optional comparator/diagnostic adapters, not WP805 authorities.
WP804 goal-change recovery stays conditional until its public consumer boundary is admitted.

Mandatory falsifiers include early dependency break, irrelevant local change, small-world full-replan-wins, generation/digest drift rejection, family leakage rejection and hidden-oracle leakage rejection.
High reuse fraction is not success; only validated retained actions count, and full replanning is allowed to win.
external_basis: World Model Recovery in SFT LLM Planners arXiv:2606.03685

handoff: Trigger 4 should implement only the bounded paired-fixture evaluator/candidate contract and falsifiers, or record a dependency-correct hold. Trigger 6 grants no build/runtime acceptance.
